decisions.question: Do catalog additional actions run at their named lifecycle moments and bracket the public save/print operations?
evidence_read: ISO 32000-2 EC3 Table 200, physical pp.524–525 / printed pp.509–510.
crates/pdf-model/src/view/script_sites.rs::run_document_scripts and current Viewer save/print/close call sites.
crates/viewer-core/tests/document_trigger_timing_audit.rs assertions for serialized WS value, post-save DS value, WC report order, WP print-page ink, DP state, and no-op Finish.
crates/viewer-core/tests/document_trigger_timing_residual_audit.rs assertions separating actual save/print from held or refused operations.
crates/pdf-script/tests/document_events.rs direct trigger identity, rc and engine-enabled WS edit assertions.
decisions.verdict: Reaffirm the five call points narrowly. Existing tests reach public Viewer lifecycle operations and observe effects/ordering, with additional tests for denied or held policies. No distinct missing Table 200 event-dispatch test identified.
decisions.qualification: ISO's rows state when an optional ECMAScript action shall be performed. The non-veto behavior for rc=false, script-level availability, restriction policy, and user-facing reporting include explicit owner decisions in ADR 1614 / CLAUDE.md, and should not be attributed solely to Table 200.

decisions.question: Does Table 200 /DS depend on a save actually being written, distinct from XFA cleanup postSave?
evidence_read: Table 200 /DS says after saving a document.
document_trigger_timing_residual_audit.rs compares Off, On, Ask-no, Ask-yes, and XFA cleanup event traces.
decisions.verdict: Reaffirm the narrow boundary. DS is absent when no file was written; XFA postSave cleanup is a separate XFA lifecycle and may run after cancellation. Existing public test has the needed affirmative and negative outcomes.

decisions.question: Are the form-field additional action triggers wired to the relevant field edit, format, commit, and calculation consumer?
evidence_read: ISO 32000-2 EC3 Table 199, physical p.524 / printed p.509.
pdf-model view scripts and field commit/format call paths.
decisions.verdict: Reaffirm only the sampled dispatch: K and F have an exact recorded site sequence and displayed-value oracle; the field calculation route has an independently literal total through public Viewer edits. V/commit ordering and richer form behavior are documented implementation choices in ADR 1603 and its RFC/reference inputs, not fully entailed by Table 199's event rows. No distinct missing trigger-cell test identified.

decisions.question: Does this cell audit change the existing initial Catalog OpenAction/page O/annotation PO ordering finding?
evidence_read: Tables 197 and 198 ordering language on physical pp.523–524 / printed pp.508–509.
Current findings.json B22 and expected-failures.json identify the public exact-order test and its observed failure/controls.
decisions.verdict: No. B22 remains a separate, established finding. This shard does not copy it into Table 199 or Table 200 coverage.

no_draft_reason: The selected Table 199 and 200 entry groups already have direct event/consumer assertions, including positive and non-trigger/denied controls; drafting duplicate cases would add no distinct source-derived oracle.
